feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Google parent company takes $500bn market hit over AI fears
articles.summary: Shares in Google's parent Alphabet are on course for one of their sharpest one-day falls on record.

articles.title: Overweight offshore workers 'could lose their jobs' under new rules
articles.summary: Hundreds of offshore workers could be at risk of losing their jobs when a new weight limit comes into effect next month, an industry body has warned.

articles.title: Bridgepoint lands former RAF chief as defence investments take off
articles.summary: Bridgepoint, the London-listed private equity group, has recruited a former head of the Royal Air Force (RAF) as it seeks to tap into a growing pipeline of security and defence-related investments across Europe.

articles.title: Finsbury Foods-owner DBAY bakes plan for sale
articles.summary: The private equity investor which took Finsbury Food Group private in 2023 is baking plans for a sale of the speciality cake maker.

articles.title: Will she stand? Lagarde quits European Central Bank ahead of French election
articles.summary: The French head of the European Central Bank (ECB) is to step down from the role, just months ahead of the troubled country's presidential election.

articles.title: Profits up billions at both UK's biggest mortgage provider and major oil producer
articles.summary: The UK's largest mortgage lender has seen profits nearly double as customers pay higher interest rates.

articles.title: US makes interest rate decision - as Bank of England verdict looms
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve has left interest rates unchanged - despite persistently high inflation and repeated calls from Donald Trump to lower borrowing costs.

articles.title: JPMorgan Chase faces £100m-plus tax bill from Healey raid
articles.summary: JPMorgan Chase will pay additional taxes of between £100m and £150m as a result of the corporation tax surcharge hike announced by John Healey in his budget on Wednesday - a bill which could renew doubts about the construction of its new London headquarters.

articles.title: Main budget announcements at a glance
articles.summary: Chancellor John Healey has unveiled the long-anticipated budget, the first for Prime Minister Andy Burnham.

articles.title: Poundland closer to collapse as it files notice to appoint administrators
articles.summary: Poundland has filed notice to appoint administrators, bringing it one step closer to collapse.
